messages:
jordan_support: Heads up — ACME reported a sustained p95 spike on /generate (hosted) starting 2026-03-15 14:20 UTC. We need a repro kit: request IDs, curl reproductions, HAR, promptset, concurrency profile, and token counts. Initial IDs from the ticket: req-0a1b2c3d, req-0a1b2c3e, req-0a1b2c3f. Who can grab a debug bundle and produce curl stubs? cc @kiran_sre @emily_eng :eyes:

kiran_sre: I can pull traces and orchestration logs. Which exact route & model? Also need timeframe and user-agent to match client behavior. Please redact auth headers when sharing. I can run vegeta stress runs with concurrency tiers 80/160/320 and token caps 512/1024.

emily_eng: From the customer ticket: model=redwood-large-v2, route=/v1/generate (POST), timeframe=2026-03-15T14:18:00Z → 2026-03-15T14:28:00Z. Client UA = acme-payments/2.3. Additional req id seen: req-1b2c3d4e. I'll assemble curl stubs and a compact promptset. Example curl stub:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-v2","prompt":"<PROMPT>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Replace <PROMPT> with entries from the promptset. I'll include per-prompt token counts.

jordan_support: Thanks — when you upload, include per-request token_in and token_out, and the sampling params (top_k/top_p/temp). We also need warm vs cold KV-cache variants; customer reports p95 ≈ 1400ms (baseline ≈ 300ms).

kiran_sre: Pulled a trace sample and a quick log snippet from the window: `instance=dedicated-gpu-17 latency_p95=1378ms`, GPU mem=14GB/24GB, CPU ~78%. Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T14:21:03Z] req=req-0a1b2c3d model=redwood-large-v2 seq_len=512 tokens_in=68 tokens_out=412 batch_id=0
[2026-03-15T14:21:03Z] fallback_to_quantized=false kernel=flash_attn2
```
I'll prepare a vegeta target and run across the following permutations: concurrency=[50,100,200], rate=200 rps, connections set to concurrency, durations 1m each, token_caps=[512,1024]. Suggested vegeta prep (prompt.json contains full json body per target):
```bash
printf '{"method":"POST","url":"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate","body":$(cat prompt.json)}' > targets.txt
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=200 -connections=200 -duration=1m | vegeta report
```
I'll capture p50/p95/p99 and latency histograms plus request-id lists for any 5xxs.

emily_eng: I'll collect HAR exports and per-request curl commands. Uploading a small promptset (5 examples) with token counts: promptA (in:34 / out:128), promptB (12/64), promptC (18/96), promptD (8/32), promptE (46/220). Also including flags for warm=true/false for KV-cache. Uploading debug bundle now.

deploy-bot: Debug bundle created by @emily_eng: https://s3.redwood.internal/debug-bundles/1965432101-acme.tar.gz (expires in 7d)

jordan_support: Ownership: @kiran_sre please run the vegeta replay across concurrency [50,100,200] with token caps 512 and 1024 and both warm/cold KV-cache modes. @emily_eng please upload promptset CSV and the set of curl stubs (one per prompt). I'll ask the customer for permission to replay a small slice of production traffic; do not replay without explicit approval. Archive the request IDs in the ticket. :thumbsup:

kiran_sre: Ack — I'll post results back in this thread with p50/p95/p99, failures by error class, and a short summary of batching behavior observed (batch sizes, KV-cache hit ratio). If I hit reproducible 502/503, I'll capture request ids and keep the debug bundle.

emily_eng: Done — promptset CSV: https://docs.redwood.internal/support/1965432101-promptset.csv ; curl stubs gist: https://gist.internal/1965432101-curl-stubs . Promptset includes a `warm` column and estimated token counts per example.

jordan_support: Great work. If the replay reproduces the p95 regression, escalate to #eng-runtime and attach the vegeta output + debug bundle. If not reproducible, we'll provide the customer a curated repro pack (curl + HAR + promptset + token matrix) and suggest a short Canary rollout for their traffic. Thanks everyone.
